resources.string: Control the music playing on this phone: TIDAL, Spotify, Deezer or any player app.

Android only shows which song is playing in another app to apps you allow under Notification access. AmF X1 uses this access only to read the song title, artist and artwork and to send play, pause, next, previous and seek. It does not read, store or send your notifications, and it never records or downloads music. You can turn it off again at any time in the same place.
